newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SABENA MAY COOPERATE WITH VLM ON ANTWERP-LONDON.
newsitem.headline: SABENA MAY COOPERATE WITH VLM ON ANTWERP-LONDON.

text.p: Belgian national airline Sabena said on Wednesday it might join forces with Antwerp-based VLM (Vlaamse Luchttransportmaatschappij) on the Antwerp-London route.
"We are carrying out a market analysis on the Antwerp-London product and VLM is the most likely option," Sabena spokesman Eric Platteau told Reuters.
He said a final decision was due in February, adding the link was "problematic" without giving financial details.
Platteau said that Sabena was also still studying which London airport to fly to once a deal had been reached.
Sabena has two flights a day to Heathrow and VLM has four services a day to London City.
